items.description: Air conditioning unit - living room, like-for-like replacement
items.rationale: Lightning overvoltage (2.3.3) damaged a fixed, permanently wired unit about 7 m from the hob, so the 5 m exclusion in 2.3.10(c) does not apply. The like-for-like replacement is indemnified under 7.1.1(c)/7.1.9, taken at the upper customary price.

items.description: Air conditioning unit - kitchen, wall-mounted near hob
items.rationale: Climate-control equipment within 5 m of a cooking appliance is conclusively excluded for overvoltage damage under 2.3.10(c), and no kitchen climate endorsement is on the schedule.

Removal, fitting and commissioning labour for a covered replacement is indemnified under 7.1.9(c) and follows its principal item (7.1.11). In earlier cases this line was never paid, so the probability is moderated.
This is an ancillary charge on an excluded principal item (2.3.10(c)), so it falls with it under 7.1.11.
The original console was scorched and cannot be reused, and an equivalent one is needed to set the replacement in place, so it is covered under 7.1.9(b).
Freight covers both units, so under 7.1.11 it is apportioned by value. Only the living-room unit's share (about half) is indemnified as ordinary carriage under 7.1.12.
